- Project: eza
- Source language: Rust
- Target language: Python

Hard constraints:
- Do not use Docker.
- Do not search the internet.
- Do not look for, copy, adapt, vendor, install, or import an existing Python implementation, clone, wrapper, compatibility layer, or package for this application.
- Use ./rust-reference and the official reference CLI as the only functional sources of truth.
- Implement in Python.
- Do not shell out to the official reference CLI from your implementation.
- Do not install packages that already implement this application or its command suite.
- The root deliverable must include ./compile.sh.
- ./compile.sh must build or wrap your Python implementation and leave a runnable root command named ./executable. On Windows, ./executable.exe or ./executable.cmd is also accepted.
- The first entrypoint discovered by the evaluator must itself be directly runnable on the current OS/runtime; do not leave a higher-priority wrapper, placeholder, or script that requires a different interpreter than the evaluator will use.
- The harness will run ./compile.sh and then invoke your runnable executable with the same argv used for the official reference CLI.

- Keep the actual implementation in one or more Python files, for example ./main.py or ./eza_port.py.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Broad exact-output matrix for the eza port's benchmark behavior area."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REFERENCE = Path((ROOT / "REFERENCE_BINARY.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
+CANDIDATE = ROOT / "eza_port.py"
+FIXTURE = ROOT / ".tura" / "eza-matrix-fixture"
+COMMON = ["--color=never", "--icons=never"]
+
+
+def prepare() -> None:
+    directories = [
+        FIXTURE,
+        FIXTURE / "d1",
+        FIXTURE / "d1" / "sub",
+        FIXTURE / "d1" / "sub" / "deep",
+        FIXTURE / "D2",
+        FIXTURE / "empty",
+        FIXTURE / ".hidden-dir",
+    ]
+    for directory in directories:
+        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    files = {
+        ".dot": 3,
+        "a01": 1,
+        "a1": 10,
+        "a2": 100,
+        "A3": 1_000,
+        "a10": 1_024,
+        "b": 9_999,
+        "README": 10_000,
+        "notes.md": 99_999,
+        "script.py": 100_000,
+        "upper.TXT": 999_999,
+        "lower.txt": 1_000_000,
+        "x.tar.gz": 1_048_576,
+        "space file.log": 17,
+        "d1/child.dat": 42,
+        "d1/sub/grandchild": 43,
+        "d1/sub/deep/bottom.txt": 44,
+        "D2/second": 45,
+        ".hidden-dir/inside": 46,
+    }
+    for index, (name, size) in enumerate(files.items()):
+        path = FIXTURE / name
+        with path.open("wb") as handle:
+            handle.truncate(size)
+        timestamp = 1_550_000_000 + index * 100_003
+        os.utime(path, (timestamp, timestamp))
+    for index, directory in enumerate(reversed(directories)):
+        timestamp = 1_650_000_000 + index * 100_019
+        os.utime(directory, (timestamp, timestamp))
+    try:
+        link = FIXTURE / "link-to-a1"
+        if not os.path.lexists(link):
+            link.symlink_to("a1")
+        directory_link = FIXTURE / "link-to-d1"
+        if not os.path.lexists(directory_link):
+            directory_link.symlink_to("d1", target_is_directory=True)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+
+def cases() -> list[tuple[list[str], bytes, dict[str, str]]]:
+    values: list[tuple[list[str], bytes, dict[str, str]]] = []
+
+    def add(arguments: list[str], data: bytes = b"", env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> None:
+        values.append((arguments, data, env or {}))
+
+    add(COMMON + ["."])
+    for hidden in ([], ["-a"], ["-A"], ["-aa"]):
+        add(hidden + ["-1"] + COMMON + ["."])
+    for width in (0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 60, 100, 200):
+        add(["-G", "-w", str(width)] + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-x", "-w", str(width)] + COMMON + ["."])
+    for sort_field in (
+        "name", "Name", ".name", ".Name", "extension", "Extension",
+        "size", "modified", "age", "accessed", "created", "type", "none",
+    ):
+        add(["-1a", f"--sort={sort_field}"] + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-1a", f"--sort={sort_field}", "--reverse"] + COMMON + ["."])
+    for grouping in ("--group-directories-first", "--group-directories-last"):
+        add(["-1a", grouping] + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-1a", grouping, "--reverse"] + COMMON + ["."])
+    for filtering in (
+        ["-D"], ["-f"], ["-D", "-f"], ["--no-symlinks"],
+        ["-D", "--show-symlinks"], ["-f", "--show-symlinks"],
+        ["-I", "*.txt|d*"], ["-I=*.md|A*"],
+    ):
+        add(["-1a"] + filtering + COMMON + ["."])
+
+    long_variants = [
+        ["-l"], ["-la"], ["-laB"], ["-lab"], ["-lah"],
+        ["-la", "--no-permissions"], ["-la", "--no-filesize"],
+        ["-la", "--no-time"],
+        ["-la", "--no-permissions", "--no-filesize"],
+        ["-la", "--no-permissions", "--no-filesize", "--no-time"],
+        ["-la", "--time-style=default"], ["-la", "--time-style=iso"],
+        ["-la", "--time-style=long-iso"], ["-la", "--time-style=full-iso"],
+        ["-la", "--time-style=+%Y/%m/%d-%H:%M:%S"],
+        ["-la", "--accessed", "--time-style=long-iso"],
+        ["-la", "--created", "--time-style=long-iso"],
+        ["-la", "--sort=size"], ["-la", "--sort=modified", "-r"],
+    ]
+    for variant in long_variants:
+        add(variant + COMMON + ["."])
+    for width in (20, 40, 80, 160):
+        add(["-lG", "-w", str(width)] + COMMON + ["."])
+
+    for level in (None, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4):
+        limit = [] if level is None else ["-L", str(level)]
+        add(["-T"] + limit + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-Ta"] + limit + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-lT"] + limit + COMMON + ["."])
+        add(["-R"] + limit + COMMON + ["."])
+    for variant in (
+        ["-T", "--sort=size"], ["-T", "--reverse"], ["-TaD"], ["-Taf"],
+        ["-Ta", "-I", "*.txt|D*"], ["-R", "-f"], ["-R", "-D"],
+        ["-Ra"], ["-lR", "-L", "3"],
+    ):
+        add(variant + COMMON + ["."])
+
+    add(["-1"] + COMMON + ["a1", "space file.log"])
+    add(["-1"] + COMMON + ["a1", "d1"])
+    add(["-1"] + COMMON + ["d1", "D2"])
+    add(["-ld"] + COMMON + ["d1", "a1"])
+    add(["-T", "-L", "2"] + COMMON + ["d1", "D2"])
+    add(["-1", "--absolute=on"] + COMMON + ["d1/sub/grandchild"])
+    add(["-1a", "--no-quotes"] + COMMON + ["."])
+    for classify in ("always", "auto", "never"):
+        add(["-1a", f"--classify={classify}"] + COMMON + ["."])
+
+    for precedence in (
+        ["-l", "-1"], ["-1", "-l"], ["-T", "-G"], ["-G", "-T"],
+        ["-l", "-G"], ["-l", "-T"], ["-T", "-l", "-G"],
+    ):
+        add(precedence + ["-w", "80"] + COMMON + ["."])
+
+    add(["--stdin", "-1"] + COMMON, b"a1\nd1\n")
+    add(["--stdin", "-1"] + COMMON, b"a1|a2|", {"EZA_STDIN_SEPARATOR": "|"})
+    add(["--stdin", "-1"] + COMMON + ["A3"], b"a1\n")
+
+    for invalid in (
+        ["--wat"], ["-q"], ["--long=yes"], ["--sort"], ["--sort=wat"],
+        ["--width=wat"], ["-R", "-L", "wat"], ["-Taa"],
+        ["--classify=sometimes"], ["--absolute=sometimes"],
+    ):
+        add(list(invalid))
+    add(["--version"])
+    add(["-v"])
+    add(["--help"])
+    return values
+
+
+def run(command: list[str], arguments: list[str], data: bytes, extra_env: dict[str, str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
+    environment = os.environ.copy()
+    for key in list(environment):
+        if key == "COLUMNS" or key == "TIME_STYLE" or key == "NO_COLOR" or key == "LS_COLORS" or key.startswith(("EZA_", "EXA_")):
+            environment.pop(key, None)
+    environment.update(extra_env)
+    return subprocess.run(
+        command + arguments,
+        cwd=FIXTURE,
+        input=data,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        env=environment,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    prepare()
+    matrix = cases()
+    failures = 0
+    for arguments, data, extra_env in matrix:
+        expected = run([str(REFERENCE)], arguments, data, extra_env)
+        actual = run([sys.executable, str(CANDIDATE)], arguments, data, extra_env)
+        if (expected.returncode, expected.stdout, expected.stderr) == (
+            actual.returncode, actual.stdout, actual.stderr
+        ):
+            continue
+        failures += 1
+        print("FAIL", " ".join(arguments))
+        if expected.returncode != actual.returncode:
+            print(f"  status expected={expected.returncode}, actual={actual.returncode}")
+        if expected.stdout != actual.stdout:
+            print(f"  stdout expected={expected.stdout[:600]!r}")
+            print(f"  stdout actual  ={actual.stdout[:600]!r}")
+        if expected.stderr != actual.stderr:
+            print(f"  stderr expected={expected.stderr[:600]!r}")
+            print(f"  stderr actual  ={actual.stderr[:600]!r}")
+    if failures:
+        print(f"{failures}/{len(matrix)} matrix cases failed")
+        return 1
+    print(f"{len(matrix)} matrix cases passed")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
